BAYZAT DESIGN TASK · PRODUCT CONCEPT

SyncAI

Meetings that lead to action

A mobile workflow connecting meeting preparation, live capture and follow-up.

ROLEProduct designer
FORMATMobile UI and Figma prototype
STATUSDesign challenge / concept
Explore the Figma prototype

01The problem

Meeting notes, decisions and assigned work can end up in separate places. SyncAI explores a single mobile journey that helps teams prepare, follow the conversation and see what needs to happen afterwards.

02My design contribution

This Bayzat design task brings together mobile screen design, reusable interface components, light and dark themes, and connected prototype navigation. The Figma file includes onboarding, a meeting dashboard, agenda creation, live transcription, summaries, task lists and preferences.

03Before, during and after

Before a meeting, users can enter attendees and an agenda or request an AI-generated draft. During the meeting, speaker-labelled transcripts highlight actions and decisions. Afterwards, a structured summary brings together key points and proposed tasks with owners and priorities.

04Design decisions

The home screen prioritises ongoing meetings and quick actions. Transcript labels distinguish commitments from decisions. The summary separates the overview from assigned work. Notification and summary preferences let users tailor how the assistant fits their routine.

05Prototype scope

This is a product design concept, not a shipped AI service. The prototype demonstrates interface states and navigation; transcription, AI generation, calls and third-party integrations are proposed capabilities. No measured business or usability outcomes are claimed.

06What I would test next

I would test whether participants can find a decision, understand who owns a task and correct an AI-generated assignment. Further design work would cover recording consent, source-linked summaries, task confirmation, search results and the complete publish-and-share journey.
